title: Emulator: guard against stack overflow and spec 429 on Rust explain
description: The emulator has a 64 KiB stack with no overflow guard; a runaway recursion corrupts memory silently. Add a guard that faults with a friendly message. Also spec the 429 concurrency path for Rust explain (shares route code with C).
right_now_summary: The emulator needs a stack overflow guard and a Rust explain 429 concurrency spec.
